purpose: Locate the SPIn strict unary loss under a single graph-free K4 probability compiler and scalar renderer by changing only exact-MPR versus compact-field representation.

representation_ladder.name: exact_capability
representation_ladder.source: official DINOv3 and SAM3 adaptor projection before exact MPR

representation_ladder.name: exact_raw_adapted
representation_ladder.source: exact raw RADIO MPR followed by the same frozen official DINOv3/SAM3 adaptors

representation_ladder.name: compact_field
representation_ladder.source: compact canonical RADIO field followed by the same in-process frozen official DINOv3/SAM3 adaptor modules

required_outputs: full global-row primitive unary logits and probabilities with valid mask
per-target rendered unary sealed before target-mask access
reference-only calibrated IoU on the frozen 0.99..0.03 grid

interpretation.compact_close_to_exact_capability: the remaining SPIn deficit is mainly observation/correspondence/query-interface rather than compact compression
interpretation.exact_capability_materially_above_compac: field compression/readout remains a causal SPIn unary bottleneck
interpretation.exact_raw_materially_below_exact_capabil: projection-before-MPR preserves task capability lost by adaptor-after-fusion

gpu.temperature_policy: check only before and after; abort only above 88C twice consecutively
